title: The completion corollary omits consistency and claims more than low basis gives.
details: Cenzer–Remmel2017, Theorem3.4.1 p110, visually checked, states that any axiomatizable theory has a complete consistent extension of low c.e. degree. An inconsistent finite theory, for example one containing a contradiction, has no consistent extension at all. The cited low-basis theorem also concludes low degree, not low c.e. degree. The checked applicable correction is: every consistent effectively axiomatized theory with effective sentence/proof syntax has a complete consistent extension of low degree, by the nonempty computable completion-tree representation and ordinary low basis. The additional c.e.-degree qualification is not supplied by that argument and is excluded. This finding concerns the inspected claim, not a whole logical-theory chapter audit.
